description: A slow, long answer (about 2000 small chunks, 50 ms apart) to press Stop on.
harness: Stop cancels the HTTP request at once; the partial text is kept; stop reason user_cancelled.

steps.text: The renderer owns the frame loop: it polls the window, advances the simulation by a fixed step and presents. Player movement is integrated with explicit Euler in player_update, so the position changes by velocity times dt.
